title: 32 GB graphics cards
evidence: Not certified (L2x, RTX 5090 under a 26 GB cap): Qwen3.8 27B as QLoRA from its 16-bit checkpoint took the computer's free commit from 33 GB to 0.8 GB while loading and was ended, and Qwen3.5 9B bf16 LoRA at 32K was ended the same way. A pre-quantized 4-bit 27B checkpoint (22.3 GB) avoids the 16-bit load; measure it on a computer with nothing else running or a larger page file.
